findings.description: BUG-1 changed cleanup from in-memory mutation to a MongoDB update_many query, which means cleanup_expired() now issues a database write for every expired approval. If this runs on a schedule with many expired approvals, consider adding a limit or batch size.

BUG-3 instantiates RecommendationRepository() inside the accept/reject endpoints to fetch the recommendation for authorization. The rest of the codebase uses the RecommendationEngine service. Either pass the repository through dependency injection or call engine.get_recommendation(id) if the engine exposes it.

findings.issue: Error message sanitization bundled with authorization fixes
findings.description: Commits for BUG-4 and BUG-5 include unrelated changes that replace detailed error messages with 'Internal server error'. These should have been separate commits (not blocking, but breaks single-responsibility).

findings.issue: MongoDB collection helper usage in BUG-1
findings.description: The migration uses col('approvals') from core.database correctly, matching the documented pattern, but the indexes are created in _ensure_indexes() which is defined but never called. The indexes won't be created unless this method is invoked during service initialization.
